source_note: 对含参数方程根的估计
english_source_note: Estimates for Roots of Parameterized Equations
callout_id: 对含参数方程根的估计#5
statement_en:
Let \((\\Omega,\\mathcal{F},\\mu)\) be a measure space, and let \\(\\{f_{\\alpha}\\}_{\\alpha\\in A}\\) be a family of measurable functions. Suppose there exists an integrable function \(g\\ge 0\) such that
\\[
|f_{\\alpha}|\\le g,\\quad \\forall \\alpha\\in A.
\\]
If \(f_{\\alpha}\	o f\) almost everywhere, then
\\[
\\int_{\\Omega} f_{\\alpha}\\,d\\mu \	o \\int_{\\Omega} f\\,d\\mu.
\\]
callout_body: $(\Omega,\mathcal{F},\mu)$是一个测度空间，$\{f_{\alpha}\}_{\alpha \in A}$是一个可测函数族，并且存在一个可积函数$g\geq 0$使得$$|f_{\alpha}|\leq g ,\forall \alpha \in A$$那么如果$f_{\alpha}$几乎处处收敛到$f$，那么$$\int_{\Omega}f_{\alpha}\,d\mu\to \int_{\Omega}f\,d\mu$$
